note: Utility iso ground tiles: manhole covers, storm-drain grates and a steel road plate set flush into asphalt. COMPOSED from isoground/asphalt.png (128x81) by painting features onto the diamond TOP face only (apex (64,0), left (0,32), right (127,32), bottom (64,64)); the extruded asphalt sides below y=32 are left untouched. Features are drawn in ground-coords (u,v) in [0,1]^2 mapped to pixel (64+64u-64v, 32u+32v), so round manholes become 2:1 squashed ELLIPSES lying flat on the diamond (centred near (64,32)) and rectangular grates/plates become parallelograms aligned to the diamond edges. Same diamond format/metrics as env/isoground and env/crosswalk.
